description: Upload a Rego policy under the given ID. Replaces any existing policy with that ID; `replaced` says whether one existed. The policy is uploaded as raw text/plain and OPA compiles it on the server, so a policy that does not compile comes back as INVALID_REGO with OPA's errors, and nothing is stored.

id.description: Policy ID to create or replace.

name: opa_put_policy
title: Upload or replace OPA policy
